svg.text: Product laws under the New Legislative Framework: changes in parallel
Which files change which product law: announced, pending and adopted since Oct 2024; data of 10 October 2026.

cc:Work.dc:title: NLF product laws and the files that change them in parallel
cc:Work.dc:creator: Steffen Zimmermann
cc:Work.dc:rights: Steffen Zimmermann, EU regulation timeline, https://git-z0man.github.io/eu-regulation-timeline/, CC BY 4.0

g.title: European Product Act (not proposed yet)
Sectoral alignment omnibus (announced with the European Product Act, not proposed yet)

Proposal for a Directive amending Directives 2000/14/EC, 2011/65/EU, 2013/53/EU, 2014/29/EU, 2014/30/EU, 2014/31/EU, 2014/32/EU, 2014/33/EU, 2014/34/EU, 2014/35/EU, 2014/53/EU, 2014/68/EU and 2014/90/EU as regards digitalisation and common specifications

Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) No 765/2008, (EU) 2016/424, (EU) 2016/425, (EU) 2016/426, (EU) 2023/1230, (EU) 2023/1542 and (EU) 2024/1781 as regards digitalisation and common specifications
Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746 as regards simplifying and reducing the burden of the rules on medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices
Proposal for a Regulation on European standardisation, repealing Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012
Proposal for a Regulation on public contracts and concessions, repealing Directives 2014/23/EU, 2014/24/EU and 2014/25/EU

Regulation (EU) 2024/2748 amending Regulations (EU) No 305/2011, (EU) 2016/424, (EU) 2016/425, (EU) 2016/426, (EU) 2023/988 and (EU) 2023/1230 as regards emergency procedures for the conformity assessment, presumption of conformity, adoption of common specifications and market surveillance due to an internal market emergency
Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 on horizontal cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements
Regulation (EU) 2025/327 on the European Health Data Space and amending Directive 2011/24/EU and Regulation (EU) 2024/2847
Regulation (EU) 2025/2509 on the safety of toys and repealing Directive 2009/48/EC

Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2023/1230 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI)

g.text: From the titles of the proposals and acts ("amending …", "repealing …"); provisions can change other acts without naming them in the title, and an agreed text can differ from the proposal. OJ ~: forecast median.
Announced: the Commission's intention; Parliament and Council have not given their views. Data of 10 Oct 2026.
